concept: Wiring prints the relations between parts on the face itself, the way a schematic pedal face joins a knob to the circuit it shapes. It draws a printed box around a group of parts, hairlines of ink with one bend at most joining them, and one short lowercase word on a line, so a person sees that the thermostat sets the heater before touching anything.

default_to_avoid.pattern: node graph editor in the React Flow manner, bezier curve wiring between coloured ports
default_to_avoid.why_not: Curves and coloured ports are an editing tool for a programmer; P8 asks for printing on the case with right angles, ink only and nothing that moves or is dragged.

default_to_avoid.pattern: wiring drawn as straight diagonal lines from the centre of one part to the centre of another
default_to_avoid.why_not: A diagonal cuts across the printing on the parts and changes angle whenever the layout moves, and P8 keeps lines on the module grid that never cross a label.

references.source: The user's wave 4 reference: a pedal whose face is a schematic, with boxes and lines joining the knobs
IEC 60617 graphical symbols for diagrams: orthogonal conductors, junction dots and grouped functional units in a dashed or solid frame
WAI-ARIA aria-describedby: a description is read after the name when a control takes focus

derivation.consequence: lines run on the module grid between the parts they join, with right angles and one bend at most, and never cross a label
derivation.form: Lines are routed from measured node positions, snapped to the module, as one straight run or one L, and any route that crosses a part or a label is dropped for the other L.

derivation.consequence: a relation is a hairline of ink with a small node where it meets a part; a group of related parts sits inside one printed box
derivation.form: Each link is a hairline path with a small dot at both ends on the part's edge, and Wiring.Group prints a hairline box with its lowercase name on the inset line.

derivation.consequence: lines are secondary ink; a relation that is active right now prints at full ink
derivation.form: A waiting link uses text.secondary with hollow end dots, an active link text.primary with filled dots, so the state also has a shape.

derivation.consequence: one grotesk, regular and medium only; hierarchy by size and position
derivation.form: A line's label is set at caption size in the regular weight, and the label of an active link turns medium, never a second face.

derivation.consequence: values change at once; only a segment's on/off fades, ≤80ms
derivation.form: Lines never travel; when a link turns active its ink steps over motion.segment, the same short fade a display segment uses.

options.name: schematic face, a printed box around the group and one bend ink lines on the module grid with end dots and a lowercase label
bus rail, every part drops a line to one shared rail along the foot of the face
numbered key, matching printed numerals at both ends and the sentences printed as a legend
direct lines, straight diagonals from centre to centre like a node editor

variants.reason: A joins each pair of parts directly with right angles, one bend and a word on the line, which is P8 as written; B loses which part drives which on a shared rail, C makes the eye travel twice to join two numerals, and D crosses the parts' printing.

root.why: The root is printing on the body it sits on, paints no surface and adds no height of its own.

field.why: The parts keep the layout the screen gives them, so drawing the lines never moves a part.

wires.why: The lines sit in one flat layer under the parts and never take a pointer, so they are printing and not a rail.

line.why: Each relation is one hairline path of ink with right angles and at most one bend.

dot.why: A small dot marks the place where a line meets the edge of a part it joins.

tag.why: One short lowercase word sits beside its line, above a level run or beside an upright one.

group.why: A group is a named set of related parts, printed as a lowercase name over one box.

groupLabel.why: The box's lowercase name sits just above the frame on its inset line, printed flat.

box.why: Related parts sit inside one hairline box whose corner nests the parts at an even inset.

node.why: A node is a named group, and its controls carry the sentences of the lines that touch it as descriptions.

relations.why: Every relation is also a sentence in a list that only assistive technology reads, so the lines are never the only telling.

data-state=on.why: An active relation prints its line, its dots and its word at full ink, and the word turns medium.

@media prefers-reduced-motion: reduce.why: Under reduced motion the ink step happens at once with no fade, since nothing has to be followed.

@media forced-colors: active.why: In forced colours the lines, dots and words take the system text colour so every relation survives.

stroke.why: The line's ink steps over motion.segment when the relation turns active, the length of a display segment's fade.

fill.why: The end dots fill over the same motion.segment as the line, so line and dots change as one.

color.why: The word on the line steps its ink over motion.segment together with its line.
